name: scene-export-worker
description: Worker-path rung for whole-scene 3D export (Q-3DEXPORT tail). Proves REAL `new Worker(new URL('./exportWorker.worker.ts', ...))` construction works under the bundler (unit tests inject a fake Worker, so broken worker wiring would otherwise be silently masked by the direct fallback): forces the worker path via the dev-only `__forceWorkerExport` seam, runs a GLB export, and asserts `__lastSceneExport.path === 'worker'` (NOT 'worker-fallback-direct') with a plausible byte length. Also records whether the DEFAULT furnished scene would exceed the worker threshold naturally (`__defaultExportStats`).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: compute-default-scene-stats
steps.eval: (async () => { const acc = await import('/src/scene/sceneExportAccess.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 150 && !acc.getSceneRoot(); i++) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const root = acc.getSceneRoot(); if (!root) { console.log('[verify] scene root never became ready'); return; } const { buildExportRoot } = await import('/src/export/sceneGltf.ts'); const { computeExportStats, shouldUseWorkerExport } = await import('/src/export/exportThreshold.ts'); const stats = computeExportStats(buildExportRoot(root)); window.__defaultExportStats = { ...stats, workerPath: shouldUseWorkerExport(stats) }; console.log('[verify] default-scene export stats: ' + JSON.stringify(window.__defaultExportStats)) })()

steps.name: verify-stats-recorded
steps.failMessage: default-scene export stats were never computed (scene root not ready?)

steps.name: verify-worker-path-ran
steps.failMessage: Worker export path did not run (path !== 'worker' — a fallback here means real Worker construction/bundler wiring is broken, or bytes were implausibly small)

steps.name: verify-success-toast
steps.failMessage: Worker export did not resolve the progress toast to success
